name: ImageBlur
source: Derived from privacy-preserving photo sharing; built on AUTOMATIC1111 WebUI v1.10.1, sd-webui-segment-anything and the sd-webui-blur extension in this suite
workflow: Detect faces and cars (GroundingDINO+SAM), blur, composite, before a photo is shared. The client and sd-webui-blur are part of this suite.

upstream_code.name: sd-webui-segment-anything
upstream_code.license: none stated (no license file in the repository)

server_patches.what: optional output_mode/mask_index fields on /sam/sam-predict (default: upstream response)

models.name: GroundingDINO SwinT-OGC
models.note: run with the extension's bundled implementation (config.json sam_use_local_groundingdino=true); text encoder bert-base-uncased from the Hugging Face hub

datasets.name: COCO 2017 val
datasets.license: annotations CC BY 4.0 (COCO Consortium); images: per-image Flickr CC licenses (recorded per row) and the Flickr Terms of Use
datasets.rule: non-crowd person and car present; largest person box >= 2% of the image

adaptations: the optional user confirmation before blurring (command-line flag of the prototype) is not part of the benchmark
input photo taken from a manifest row instead of a fixed file path
request-ID headers and client-side request logging removed; request bodies unchanged
server patch 0001 adds the output_mode/mask_index fields this client sends

development_hardware.server_gpu: NVIDIA A40 (46068 MiB visible), driver 595.71.05, torch 2.1.2+cu121
development_hardware.client: macOS laptop, Python 3.10.18, on a separate network over an SSH tunnel
